Implemented subcommand dispatch in cmd/gitops-agent; bare invocation and -version unaffected.

Rewrote docs/install.md for the binary-driven install (gitops-agent install/update, bootstrap script, migration section) and added the self-update trust tradeoff to docs/security.md.
All children (ga-tqa.1-6) closed; install and self-update now live in the binary, scripts/install.sh is the sole bootstrap entry point.
